up: Show the first 200 metabolism records where the enzyme is P450 reductase. For each record, return the substrate compound structure (canonical SMILES), the substrate compound name, the parent compound name, the metabolic conversion description, the pathway key, and the organism.
sql:
SELECT
  cs_sub.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure,
  cr_sub.compound_name AS substrate_name,
  cr_par.compound_name AS parent_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.organism
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs_sub ON md_sub.molregno = cs_sub.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr_par ON m.drug_record_id = cr_par.record_id
WHERE m.enzyme_name LIKE '%P450 reductase%'
LIMIT 200;
